The right blue is at rows 44-48, cols 39-43. It can move horizontally (left and right). Above it (rows 39-43) is open space (OOOOO). So the right blue can move up.

- DOWN: left blue moves down (right blue doesn't move, or moves differently)
- LEFT: right blue moves right (left blue doesn't move)

This makes more sense! The left blue is controlled by UP/DOWN, and the right blue is controlled by LEFT/RIGHT.
